scientific_integrity: The two-moment finite-view theorem and four-view obstruction are established by a self-contained proof. Directional forward laws and infinite-view uniqueness are explicitly credited as prior literature. Independent evaluation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only nondegenerate planar parallelograms, exact chord population moments, known directions, uniform transverse offsets.
No finite-sample estimation or universal conditioning constants.
Five is the sharp guarantee for every prescribed direction set; not every choice of four is ambiguous.
title: Five fixed chord-moment directions reconstruct every parallelogram, and four need not
